description: This file defines the NodeInterface interface within the OrangeHRM ORM NestedSet namespace, outlining methods for managing hierarchical node structures such as a tree or nested set, including operations like checking for children, retrieving parents and children, inserting nodes, and deleting nodes.

classes.name: NodeInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for node objects in a nested set hierarchy, including methods for hierarchy management and node properties.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks if the node has child nodes.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves the child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if the node has a parent node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node, or null if none exists.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the node within the hierarchy.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts the current node as the last child of the specified parent node.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a specified node as a child of the current node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the node is a leaf node (has no children).

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the node is the root of the hierarchy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the node and its descendants.
